verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a first-party Code Evaluators feature for running deterministic checks. It also supports fully custom evaluation workflows and scores via its API/SDKs, which can be used in SDK experiments (`run_experiment`). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how code evaluators are authored and executed (function signatures, supported languages, managed versus client-side execution), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of writing custom scorers.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations

citations.quote: You can combine a variety of different evaluation metrics like model-based evaluations (LLM-as-a-Judge), human annotations or fully custom evaluation workflows via API/SDKs.
